title: Work Deeply
coreMove: Convert a wish to focus into a calendar, ritual, and shutdown rule that make depth repeatable.
sourcePressure: The source frame names scheduling philosophies, rituals, and shutdown routines as the way to create regular depth.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version says block time; the chapter must show how an operating system reduces reliance on mood.

exampleSpecs.domain: a pediatric oncology pharmacist verifying a chemotherapy protocol
exampleSpecs.audience: a clinician whose deep work cannot depend on leftover attention
exampleSpecs.stakes: a dose schedule must be exact before the treatment window opens
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she starts the same verification ritual every morning: locked workstation, printed protocol, silent double-check, then documented shutdown
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a chemo protocol sheet under a clear plastic cover at 6:55 a.m.

exampleSpecs.domain: a documentary editor cutting an interview sequence
exampleSpecs.audience: a creative professional whose output suffers when deep sessions start differently every day
exampleSpecs.stakes: the film loses its emotional line if the sequence is assembled between interruptions
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he creates a start ritual with transcript pages, source clips, and a no-export rule until the argument of the sequence is clear
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a timeline filled with purple interview clips and two marked transcript pages

exampleSpecs.domain: a patent examiner reviewing a dense biomedical claim set
exampleSpecs.audience: a specialist who needs repeatable entry into hard reading
exampleSpecs.stakes: a poor review either blocks a valid claim or lets a weak one pass
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she chooses a bimodal day: claim analysis before noon, correspondence after lunch, and records the shutdown question that closes the file
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a claim chart with five dependent claims circled in red

exampleSpecs.domain: a high-school robotics mentor preparing competition strategy
exampleSpecs.audience: a mentor balancing student access with planning depth
exampleSpecs.stakes: the team wastes build time if the autonomous route is not designed carefully
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he tells students the door reopens after the strategy block, then writes the route assumptions before answering build questions
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a field map taped to a folding table with colored path lines

exampleSpecs.domain: a tax attorney preparing a complex cross-border memo
exampleSpecs.audience: a professional whose deep work must coexist with client demands
exampleSpecs.stakes: the client makes a costly filing decision if the memo is thin
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: after losing a morning to calls, she builds a ritual: statute book open, call window posted, memo question written before the first paragraph
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a treaty article printed beside a blank memo heading

exampleSpecs.domain: a prosthetics designer refining socket fit for a runner
exampleSpecs.audience: a design specialist whose depth needs a physical setup and end condition
exampleSpecs.stakes: a poorly shaped socket causes pain during training
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she begins with the same measurement layout and ends by writing the next physical test, preventing the design from leaking into the evening
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a plaster positive marked with pressure points in blue pencil

skillTargets: choose an appropriate depth scheduling structure
design rituals that reduce startup friction
identify shutdown rules that protect recovery and resumption
distinguish repeatable systems from willpower slogans

tryThisNowSpec: Write the exact first three objects, screens, or documents that must be in place before your next deep block starts, plus the sentence that will close it.
